scope: Theorem 7.2 of the manuscript “Distortion of countably branching diamonds from midpoint and tree energies” (preprints/Diamond-distortion-from-midpoint-and-tree-energies-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 331 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d71f7eafe03d0d83), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If every infinite ε-separated symmetric R-lens satisfies ∥x∥2 ≤ R2 − bε2 for some b > 0, then every embedding (2.1) satisfies D2 ≥ 1 + 4bk. If instead (7.3) holds, then k ≤ C2 D(D − 1). (7.5)
